articles.title: Northern Glow Spans Iceland and Canada
articles.summary: A vivid display of the aurora lit up skies over the Denmark Strait and eastern Canada during a minor geomagnetic storm in February 2026.

articles.title: Pentagon seeks commercially built GEO spy satellites
articles.summary:
The Defense Innovation Unit plans to select companies to field and operate spacecraft before transferring them to government control within three years
The post Pentagon seeks commercially built GEO spy satellites  appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Digital Surface and Terrain Models from Vantor’s Precision3D Product Line Added to Satellite Data Explorer
articles.summary: The CSDA Program added three digital elevation and digital terrain products from Vantor’s Precision3D Product Line to the Satellite Data Explorer.

articles.title: Vantor Archive Imagery Added to Satellite Data Explorer
articles.summary: NASA’s Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program announces the addition of imagery from Vantor to its Satellite Data Explorer (SDX) data access and discovery tool.

articles.title: CSDA Releases New Data Acquisition Request System
articles.summary: The CSDA Program’s Data Acquisition Request System lets authorized users submit proposals for yet-to-be-collected data from CSDA’s commercial partners.
